title: Work action-authority comparator v2
description: Fail-closed containment rules for one exact consequential request under an issued heterogeneous Work authority. Customer economic value and AI/model compute spend are separate policy and ledger domains. These rules do not determine Policy outcome or imply dispatch, provider acceptance, completion, or settlement.

provider_verified.required_trusted_value_evidence: supported provider fact artifact bound to the exact request and provider body

cross_checks: signed and relational root_permit_id and authority_id must match
signed work_binding_v2 authority_canonical_hash must match the resolved authority
signed work_binding_v2 value_request must bind the exact declared amount for declared_bounded lanes and must carry no caller-declared amount for none or provider_verified lanes
signed exercised_by must match the authenticated live principal and the root delegation
a value_binding='none' lane must never reserve or consume root customer monetary value
a value_binding='provider_verified' lane must not consume caller-asserted value and is unverifiable without supported trusted provider facts
all monetary lanes under a finite root pool must use the root currency because this contract defines no exchange-rate authority
customer monetary value and AI/model compute spend must remain separate ledgers
use and customer-value reservation must succeed atomically before an executable allow child is published
final dispatch must recheck root, authority, child, delegation, principal, credential, approval, policy, reservation, revocation, expiry, and exact provider-body binding
